newsitem.title: USA: Energy Technologies Inc calls warrants.
newsitem.headline: Energy Technologies Inc calls warrants.

text.p: Energy Technologies Inc on Tuesday said it will call for the redemption of its warrants within the next thirty days.
No details were given regarding the redemption price of the warrants, the number of warrants outstanding or the option of exercising the warrants into common stock.

They said exercise of these warrants could raise nearly $600,000 for the firm and support the acquisition of materials used to manufacture ETCH's air conditioning systems, which will begin arriving at ETCH distributor locations in 1997.
